entities.summary: Yomra is a municipality and district of Trabzon Province, Turkey. Its area is 200 km2, and its population is 47,283 (2022). The town lies on the Black Sea coast, east of the city of Trabzon. The mayor is Mustafa Bıyık (CHP).
